newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK XIOSBANK CUTS BUSINESS CREDIT RATE BY 25BPS.
newsitem.headline: GREEK XIOSBANK CUTS BUSINESS CREDIT RATE BY 25BPS.

text.p: Greek private Xiosbank cut its business credit loan rate by 25 basis points to 18.50 percent after taking into consideration the new conditions in the interbank market.
Xiosbank said it had lent over 42 billion drachmas in business credit loans to over 300 clients.
Its XiosAlma deposit account which pays interest monthly will offer an annual yield of 11.02 percent for the week February 17 to February 23. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
